results.ddl_script:
-- ClickHouse DDL (MergeTree)
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS analytics;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS analytics.sales (
dt Date,amount Int64)
ENGINE = MergeTree
PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(dt)
ORDER BY tuple();
